overview: Built an automated image production system for a law firm’s social media content.
The workflow takes an approved content idea and turns it into a finished branded social media graphic, including the image, text, description, hashtags, branding, and final file management.

list: Retrieves pending content ideas from Google Sheets
Generates the image prompt, headline, description, and hashtags
Checks the generated content against predefined requirements
Creates the image using Google Gemini
Adds the firm’s logo, text, colors, and layout
Renders the final design as a 1080 × 1080 PNG
Uploads the finished graphic to Google Drive
Updates Google Sheets with the final image, description, hashtags, and status

blocks.p: The workflow automatically rotates between 12 branded templates based on the content schedule.
This keeps the content visually consistent while avoiding repetitive designs.
Google Sheets acts as the central content queue and tracking system.

result: A complete automated design pipeline that turns a content idea into a branded, review ready social media graphic without requiring manual image creation or editing for every post.
The system also keeps content, assets, and approval status organized in one workflow.
